title: Toward Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Retail Workflows over Heterogeneous Data Sources
abstract: arXiv:2610.25096v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Enterprise retail workflows require agents to chain evidence across heterogeneous sources, from structured product and order records to unstructured inquiries and reviews, yet existing agentic RAG benchmarks rarely capture this challenge. To enable controlled evaluation of such workflows, we introduce RetailBridge, a compositional retail benchmark built from persona-driven simulations. Its questions are constructed by linking entities and intermediate answers across heterogeneous sources, requiring agents to identify the relevant sources, carry evidence between them, and produce a grounded answer. To systematically evaluate LLMs on these retail workflows, we develop RetailRAG, a retail-aware framework equipped with auto-schema briefing, source-routed plan chaining, and diagnostic plan revision. RetailRAG consistently outperforms existing agentic RAG baselines across all evaluation axes, serving as a strong reference system for assess

translated_title: 面向异构数据源上企业零售工作流的代理式检索增强生成研究
translated_abstract: 企业零售工作流要求智能体在异构数据源之间串联证据——从结构化的产品和订单记录到非结构化的咨询和评论——然而现有的代理式RAG基准很少涵盖这一挑战。为了实现对这类工作流的受控评估，我们提出了RetailBridge，这是一个基于角色驱动模拟构建的组合式零售基准。其问题通过跨异构数据源链接实体和中间答案来构建，要求智能体识别相关数据源、在数据源之间传递证据，并生成有依据的答案。为了系统地在这些零售工作流上评估大语言模型，我们开发了RetailRAG，这是一个具备零售感知能力的框架，配备了自动模式简报、基于数据源路由的计划串联以及诊断性计划修订功能。RetailRAG在所有评估维度上持续优于现有的代理式RAG基线，可作为评估的强力参考系统。
tldr: 本文提出了RetailBridge零售基准和RetailRAG框架，通过自动模式简报、数据源路由计划串联和诊断性计划修订等机制，使智能体能够跨异构数据源识别、串联证据并生成有依据的答案，从而完成企业零售工作流任务，其性能在所有评估维度上全面超越现有代理式RAG基线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RetailBridge, a compositional retail benchmark built from persona-driven simulations that requires chaining evidence across heterogeneous sources, and RetailRAG, a retail-aware framework with auto-schema briefing, source-routed plan chaining, and diagnostic plan revision, which consistently outperforms existing agentic RAG baselines across all evaluation axes.
